events.content:
The product page has been updated so the title shows right away when navigating from home.

**Cause:** The page awaited `getInventory()` at the top, so the whole UI (including the title) was blocked until that async work finished.

**Change:** The page now:
1. Renders the title `"Premium Widget"` immediately as part of the static shell
2. Moves the inventory load into a separate async `ProductInventory` component
3. Wraps `ProductInventory` in `<Suspense>` so it streams in independently
4. Uses a `"Loading inventory..."` fallback while the inventory data loads

This follows the pattern from the Next.js streaming docs: keep static content outside Suspense and wrap only the async parts, so the title appears immediately while inventory loads in the background.
